visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with a handheld pan across a white marble-patterned dining table cluttered with various boxes, a pink gift bag, a transparent food container, and a tripod. (2) A woman with long dark hair, wearing a purple and white striped sweater and a light blue skirt, sits at the table, smiling brightly at a young boy who stands beside her. (3) The boy has a high ponytail, wears glasses, a black backpack, and a green and black checkered demon slayer patterned haori; he looks towards the woman. (4) The woman holds up a small transparent plastic bag containing a tiny white tooth, gesturing with her other hand while she talks enthusiastically. (5) A white labrador dog walks briefly into the frame near the table. (6) The camera zooms in on the boy's face as he opens his mouth wide to reveal a missing front tooth; a hand (likely the father's) enters the frame to gently hold the boy's chin. (7) The woman presents a box of Pokemon cards to the boy, who takes them and examines the box while they continue to talk in a well-lit indoor home setting with Mickey Mouse artwork on the wall.
